domain: Legal and scientific metrology — weights-and-measures verification, prototype and realized standards, calibration hierarchies, traceability chains with stated uncertainty, certified reference materials, and periodic inter-site comparison
axioms: A number is meaningless without a traceable chain back to the realization that produced it; an unrecorded instrument makes a stored value uninterpretable later.
An uncalibrated instrument still emits confident, plausible numbers — silence is the normal presentation of measurement failure.
A standard that defines its own correctness cannot detect its own drift; only comparison against an independent realization reveals it.
Substituting a different instrument mid-series does not produce a degraded reading, it produces a different quantity, and thresholds do not transfer between them.
A tolerance without a stated procedure, uncertainty, and reference material is not an acceptance criterion; it is an opinion.
Verification must be periodic and scheduled, because the failures worth catching announce themselves only through accumulated bias, never through an error.
A reported rate carries no authority apart from its denominator; the same value over two samples and over fifty are different claims.
primitives: unit / realization (the embedding space as realized by a specific model build, quantization, tokenizer, pooling and normalization)
prototype and copies (zklw as canonical harvester and embedder; the Mac's git-pulled store and local query embeddings)
traceability chain (stored vector back to its producing realization)
calibration certificate with stated uncertainty (the provenance the embedding matrix would carry)
certified reference material (a known-answer pair set that must and must not cluster)
periodic verification / inter-site comparison (a scheduled check that two realizations still agree)
instrument substitution (local Ollama, zklw Ollama over Tailscale, lexical fallback)
tolerance and acceptance procedure (the verified-in-the-registry gate on irreversible deletion)
reported quantity with denominator (hit-rate as upheld over upheld plus refuted, null when unadjudicated)
failure signature (loud error vs silently wrong value vs empty result indistinguishable from a true negative)
failure_mode: Indifferent to semantics: will not question what an edge type means, whether a lens is good, or whether a collapse destroyed something worth keeping — only whether the numbers behind it are traceable.
Over-indexes on instrumentation and can demand verification apparatus disproportionate to a personal single-user registry, treating every unmeasured quantity as a defect.
Blind to lineage and authority questions: canonical head choice, contamination, and what the prune destroys as evidence fall outside its frame.
Assumes measurements are the load-bearing part of the design; will underweight failures that are purely structural, ordering-related, or human-process-related with no number involved.
No view on developer experience, naming, packaging, code quality of the JS port, or how reuse feels in flux-gen and melange.
Weak on one-shot or manual operations that will only ever run a handful of times, where a full calibration regime is genuinely the wrong answer.
